Sans1

The Hanged Man

Sans is one of Springfield’s most infamous residents, and the older brother of Royal Guard Captain Papyrus. Many dislike him for his crude humor, habitual cheating, and near-total lack of value to society. During the Genocide route, the final encounter with Sans ends with him drinking himself to death.

Personality

Sans is egotistical, bitter, and self-destructive. He speaks in a lazy, drawling cadence and rarely raises his voice, but his words are sharp and aimed at whatever he thinks will hurt the most.

Appearance

Sans is a short skeleton with a wide grin that almost never falters. He wears an orange tank top with an "Eye for an Eye" print, a black beanie, black shorts, white and orange shoes, and a black jacket tied around his waist. His mouth is scarred, one eye is damaged, and his pupils are square, including the orange magic eye.

At the MTT Food Court, he wears a black suit and white shirt he found in the trash nearby.

History

Sans was born in Springfield and lived there with his younger brother, Papyrus, for most of his life. By his own account, he never succeeded at anything significant.

When Papyrus seized control of the Royal Guard, he forcefully evicted Sans and remodeled the house to suit his own needs. Sans has been homeless ever since, drifting through the city’s margins and surviving on what he can cheat out of others.

Date with the Devil

Once Valefar reaches the MTT Food Court, Sans invites them to what he calls a “date.” Throughout the encounter, he insults Valefar, loses badly, and drinks himself to death on expensive beer he puts on their tab.

Relationships

Papyrus

Sans sees Papyrus as a living reminder of his own failure. He resents his brother's success, his discipline, and his willingness to tear apart their family for power. What he would not say aloud is that some part of him still wishes Papyrus was kinder to him.

Alphys

Sans and Alphys are in a toxic romantic relationship. He knows Alphys uses him, denies him, and discards him when it suits her. But he keeps coming back anyway, because she is one of the only people who ever comes to see him at all.

Mettaton

Sans knows that Mettaton knows about his relationship with Alphys, but he can't bring himself to care.

Valefar

Sans views Valefar as a cheater and a thief, no better than himself. When the demon starts winning despite Sans's tricks, there is, behind the insults, a faint hint of respect for the dedication.

Abilities

Bone Magic

Sans is capable of summoning Bones (1 HP, 0 AT) onto the field. They do nothing but get in the way.

Deck Theft

Sans can physically reach into an opponent's deck and take cards from it.

Sharpie Scribbles

Sans possesses the ability to create new Soul Cards on ordinary paper, napkins, or the back of another card. The properties of these cards are not bound by any rules.

Gaster Blasters

Sans can summon Gaster Blasters (2 HP, 10 AT) outside the field. After a one-round charge, they fire a beam that pierces through all Soul Cards in its path.
